paper.abstract_en: Carrollian geometry has recently emerged as the proper language to understand the geometry of null hypersurfaces from an intrinsic perspective. In this paper, we demonstrate that the Noether charge associated with the intrinsic conformal symmetry of Carrollian manifolds yields exactly the dynamical entropy formula recently proposed by Hollands, Wald and Zhang. This result follows directly from the requirement that the gravitational phase space induced on a finite distance null hypersurface be anomaly-free, in a covariant phase space sense. We then show that a linearized perturbation of this dynamical entropy charge, sourced by an external matter perturbation falling across the hypersurface, satisfies a physical process first law. Moreover, upon imposing the classical null energy condition, a linearized second law holds for the dynamical entropy. We then turn to a semi-classical generalization of this construction, where we argue that a notion of dynamical generalized entropy follows from considering perturbations sourced by external quantum matter. By imposing the quantum null energy condition (QNEC), we find a generalized second law for a linearized perturbation of the dynamical generalized entropy. Finally, we use our results to speculate on relations to the quantum focusing conjecture.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该文将Carrollian几何的内禀共形对称性与Hollands-Wald-Zhang动力学熵公式联系起来，并在此基础上推导线性化第一定律、经典零能量条件下的线性化第二定律，以及半经典层面的动力学广义熵与QNEC下的广义第二定律，理论深度较高且与黑洞热力学/广义熵主题直接相关，值得进一步阅读。
decision.abstract_zh: Carrollian几何近来作为从内禀视角理解零超曲面几何的恰当语言而出现。在本文中，我们证明与Carrollian流形的内禀共形对称性相关的Noether荷恰好给出Hollands、Wald和Zhang近来提出的动力学熵公式。这一结果直接源于如下要求：在协变相空间意义下，有限距离零超曲面上诱导的引力相空间应当无反常。随后我们证明，这一动力学熵荷的线性化扰动——由穿过该超曲面的外部物质扰动所源生——满足物理过程第一定律。此外，在施加经典零能量条件后，动力学熵满足线性化第二定律。接着我们转向这一构造的半经典推广，在此我们论证：考虑由外部量子物质源生的扰动，可得到一种动力学广义熵的概念。通过施加量子零能量条件（QNEC），我们得到动力学广义熵线性化扰动的广义第二定律。最后，我们利用这些结果推测与量子聚焦猜想的可能关联。
